info.title: FinLover v1 API
info.description: Implemented operations only. Wallet create/list are available on v1; category/transaction lists, reports and current-user endpoints are not implemented. UI mock screens are not API integration.

post.description: Create a user with explicit privacy consent. confirmPassword must match password; password is limited to 72 UTF-8 bytes. Never returns passwordHash. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

409.description: Duplicate email, category, or wallet name

post.description: Set HttpOnly session_token for seven days. Missing user and wrong password produce the same credentials error. Password is limited to 72 UTF-8 bytes. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

post.description: Clear the cookie. Idempotent. Does not revoke previously issued JWTs. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

403.description: Forbidden resource or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

post.description: Create an owned custom category. Names are trimmed; duplicates conflict. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

409.description: Duplicate email, category, or wallet name

put.description: Partial update of an owned non-system category. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

409.description: Duplicate email, category, or wallet name

delete.description: Delete an owned non-system category and clear category references atomically. Transactions and wallet balances remain unchanged. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

post.description: Create an owned transaction and adjust wallet balance in one MongoDB transaction. Requires a replica set. Category must belong to the user and match the transaction type. Persisted minimum amount is 0.01. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

put.description: Replace editable fields of an owned transaction; reverse old and apply new balance atomically. wallet cannot be changed by this API. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

delete.description: Delete an owned transaction and reverse its balance atomically. Legacy success has no body. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

post.description: Create an owned wallet. Duplicate names return a name field error. Unknown input properties are accepted and stripped. There is currently no per-user wallet limit. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, ID, or missing consent

403.description: Forbidden resource or untrusted/missing Origin for cookie writes

409.description: Duplicate email, category, or wallet name

get.description: List wallets owned by the authenticated user. Authorization takes precedence over cookie. Cookie writes require an Origin in PUBLIC_ORIGINS; missing Origin is rejected. Implemented.
